contenders.handicapper_notes: Dominant synthetic sprinter from the McEvoy stable. Coming off an emphatic 1.8L win over 1100m at this track and surface on August 6 carrying 60.5kg, following a narrow second over this 1000m track on July 27. Possesses elite early sustained speed (E) and apprentice claim gives valuable weight relief.

Highly consistent performer for Ciaron Maher and John Allen. Has hit the board in three consecutive synthetic starts, including a close 2nd at Pakenham Synthetic and a solid 3rd over 1200m here seven days ago. Drawn the rails (barrier 1) which provides the perfect stalking run (P) saving ground on the sweeping bend.

Proven Ballarat Polytrack specialist with 3 track wins this winter. Raced without luck last week when flying home from last on the bend for 4th (beaten 2.1L). With intense early pace expected between Starburst and Frose, his closing burst (S) gives him maximum upside over the 400m home straight.

Veteran campaigner with 13 career victories who excels on the synthetic layout. Produced an eye-catching 3rd beaten under a length here on August 11 over 1000m carrying 54kg. Capable presser (P) who handles all conditions and gets weight relief.
Finished a respectable 4th beaten only 1.75L over this course and distance on August 11. Drawn ideally in barrier 2 to secure economical mid-pack stalking position (P) without being trapped wide.
Fitter 3rd-up today after a sound 4th at Swan Hill over 1200m. Drawn softly in barrier 3 with Harry Coffey aboard, which suits her off-pace swooping pattern (S).
